source: In-game Settings > Infantry > Infantry Mouse Aim Sensitivity, panel text "Mouse movement distances for 360 degree rotation"
unit: mouse travel for one full hipfire turn, as the panel prints it (one decimal)

siteCheck.formula: degrees per count = sensitivity x 0.0017362342283 + 0.002314981532; cm/360 = 360 / (degrees per count x DPI) x 2.54
siteCheck.result: all nine distances reproduce to the panel's displayed decimal (largest difference 0.045 cm at sensitivity 15 / 1,600 DPI and 55 / 1,600 DPI)
siteCheck.test: scripts/live-fire.test.mjs, 'hipfire cm/360 reproduces the in-game settings panel distances'

note: The constant was first taken from the KovaaK's sensitivity converter's Battlefield 6 entry (read 21 October 2026); this panel is the game's own statement of the same conversion. The ADS scaling rule (Uniform Infantry Aiming coefficient) is not covered by the panel and stays a community formula.
